card.name: Partway through years and Malay se- words
card.fires_on: Responds to the last digit of a four-digit year such as 1934 or 1918, and to the Malay prefix 'se' (meaning one) at the start of a word. Weaker on a few words like 'then' and 'whole'.

modes.label: Final digit of a year
modes.description: The last digit of a four-digit year, usually 19xx, in historical or citation text.

modes.label: Malay 'se' prefix
modes.description: The 'se' that means 'one' at the start of Malay words like seorang or sebelum.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese counting words (个, 种, 颗) and suppresses 'consisting' and 'consist', so it favors a count or classifier next.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a year or on the Malay 'se' meaning 'one', where a count or unit word may follow.
